task_completion.description: Set default font size to 'Large' (at least 20px) and minimum font size to 16px in Edge settings.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshot of Edge 'Appearance' or 'Fonts' settings page showing 'Font size' set to 'Large' (or custom 20px+) and 'Minimum font size' slider/input at 16px.

task_completion.description: Configure the browser to show the Home button on the toolbar.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Edge toolbar displays a house-shaped 'Home' icon, or the 'Show home button' toggle is enabled in settings.

task_completion.description: Set the homepage to https://www.usa.gov and configure Edge to open this page on startup.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Edge settings showing 'Open these pages' under 'On startup' with 'https://www.usa.gov' listed, and the 'Set button URL' for the Home button pointing to the same URL.

task_completion.description: Visit both usa.gov and ssa.gov to verify the configuration.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots of the browser successfully loading the USA.gov and SSA.gov websites in tabs.

task_completion.description: Create a text file at /home/ga/Desktop/accessibility_config_guide.txt with the required details.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal 'cat' command showing the file content at the specified path, containing the font size (20px/Large) and the homepage URL (usa.gov).

integrity.description: The agent used the Edge GUI to change settings rather than just editing config files via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the Edge Settings menu and toggles.

integrity.description: The agent actually navigated to the government websites rather than just typing the URL in the bar without loading.
integrity.visual_evidence: The browser viewport renders the actual content of USA.gov and SSA.gov (logos, banners, text).

integrity.description: The reference document was created by the agent during the session.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen typing the content into a text editor or using a 'touch/echo' command in the terminal.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The default font size must be at least 20px (often labeled 'Large' in Edge). The minimum font size must be exactly 16px. The homepage and startup page must be https://www.usa.gov. The agent must visit both usa.gov and ssa.gov. The reference file must be located at /home/ga/Desktop/accessibility_config_guide.txt and contain these specific font and URL values.
